# Hiseachem

> Qingdao Hisea Chem is an industrial chemical manufacturer and supplier specializing in glacial acetic acid, nitric acid, hydrogen peroxide, and a comprehensive range of organic and inorganic chemical products.

Hiseachem operates as a B2B chemical distributor based in Qingdao, China, offering bulk industrial chemicals including acids, alcohols, esters, plasticizers, ketones, amides, and chelants to manufacturers and businesses worldwide. The company provides door-to-door delivery and one-stop chemical solutions for industrial applications.
